title: A LATE-Targeting Experimental Design for Multi-Arm RCTs
abstract: arXiv:2610.25667v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the design of multi-arm experiments that identify local average treatment effects under imperfect compliance. With three or more arms, conventional randomization fails to identify margin-specific effects even under strong extensions of monotone compliance. A choice-theoretic analysis unifies these extensions and motivates a two-stage design: subjects report a preferred arm and are randomized conditional on it. If treatment is confined to the assigned or reported arm, one-sided noncompliance is restored conditional on the report, identifying the effect between the two for their compliers. We discuss the design's applicability and feasibility in relation to the choice model.

translated_title: 一种面向多臂随机对照试验的LATE目标实验设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在依从性不完美的情况下，能够识别局部平均处理效应的多臂实验设计。当存在三个或更多实验组时，即使在单调依从性假设的强扩展条件下，常规随机化也无法识别特定边际的效应。基于选择理论的分析统一了这些扩展条件，并启发了一种两阶段设计：受试者首先报告自己偏好的实验组，然后在该报告条件下进行随机化。如果处理仅限于被分配的或被报告的实验组，那么在给定报告的条件下可以恢复单侧不依从性结构，从而为依从者识别两组之间的效应。我们结合选择模型讨论了该设计的适用性与可行性。
tldr: 提出一种两阶段实验设计——受试者先报告偏好实验组、再据此条件随机化——从而在多臂随机对照试验中恢复单侧不依从性结构，实现对局部平均处理效应的识别。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-stage experimental design—subjects report a preferred arm and are then randomized conditional on it—that restores one-sided noncompliance, enabling identification of local average treatment effects in multi-arm RCTs.
